What each file was computed on, seeds and run commands: `code/README.md`; conditions and the numbers in words: `RESULTS.md`; departures from the Brief: `DEVIATIONS.md`.
  > 
  > Extra files beyond your table: `h1.csv` (H1 outcome, k-plateau, CI, censoring), `metrics_extra.csv`, `history_sweep.csv` and `history_smallest.csv` (C6; the second gives the smallest setting within 10 % of full history), `selection_cost.csv`, `transform.csv` / `transform_folds.csv` (identity vs logit choice: helm_mmlu logit, mteb_eng identity, mteb_multi logit), `theory_shape.csv` (offset vs k-dependent part of the theory gap), `adaptive.csv` (local-A adaptive vs greedy A vs random), `per_benchmark_skill.csv` and `_long.csv`, `small_panels.csv` / `small_panels_refs.csv` (HELM Lite, HELM Capabilities, llm_union16: descriptive only, N<12, no k*), `union_overlap.csv`, `licences.csv`.
  > 
  > Notes for the figures: (1) `predictors.csv` includes a `best_simple` predictor (per-fold choice among onefactor/ridge/knn/lw by inner grouped 5-fold CV on training rows only, in `results_raw/best_simple_*.json`); `kstar.csv` headline k* is the min over fa and best_simple. (2) k* censored at the grid maximum is coded grid_max+1 inside bootstraps; the CI columns and `share_censored_boot` say how often. (3) `theory_gap.csv` real-tier gaps are large (36-69 %), so Fig. 5 should show the offset and the k-dependent part separately (`theory_shape.csv`). (4) `per_benchmark_skill.csv` is a table for the appendix; the long file has one row per benchmark.
